welcome_lead: I IV V — the harmonic backbone of tonal music.

final_note: Roman numerals turn ears into eyes.

concepts.def: Notation for chord function: I (tonic), IV (subdominant), V (dominant).
V-vi — surprise turn to the relative minor.

walkthroughs.body_html: Upper case = major triad (I, IV, V); lower case = minor (ii, iii, vi). In C major: I=C, ii=Dm, V=G, vi=Am. Add inversion figures: V6 = first inversion, V6/4 = second.
Perfect (V-I), Plagal (IV-I), Imperfect (anything-V), Interrupted (V-vi). Cadences mark phrase ends and signal formal articulation.
A-Level harmonic analysis often uses Bach chorales: identify key, mark cadences, label chords with Roman numerals and figures, note modulations and chromatic decorations.
